description: Double-check and extend historical IHACPA coverage back to 2012-13 where official pricing specifications exist, while distinguishing older NHCDC cost evidence from NWAU calculator support.
completion_policy: Complete-with-gaps means the repository has a historical IHACPA provenance audit from 2012-13 through 2026-27, separate source-family matrices, foundational 2012-13 NEP and technical-specification hashes, executable inventory validation, and explicit caveats that NHCDC is costing evidence only. The track does not claim direct 2012-13 NWAU calculator support, full historical hash census coverage, or calculator parity validation for every historical year.

implemented: 2012-13 through 2026-27 historical IHACPA source provenance audit
separate NEP determination, technical specification, NWAU calculator, price-weight, NHCDC, and validation-status coverage
foundational 2012-13 NEP and technical-specification PDF hashes
explicit documentation that NHCDC is costing evidence only
not_implemented: full hash census for every historical downloadable artifact
calculator parity validation for every historical year

gap_register.summary: No direct 2012-13 NWAU calculator artifact is proven; support must not be inferred from pricing specifications or NHCDC evidence.
gap_register.rationale: The provenance audit confirms 2012-13 NEP and technical-specification sources but does not find a calculator artifact.

gap_register.summary: Foundational PDF hashes are recorded, but a full hash census across every historical artifact remains outside this provenance-audit closure.
gap_register.rationale: This track records foundational hashes and existing local archive evidence; a full historical hash census should be a separate source-archive hardening track.
